rows.description: An open-source project for Windows developers to learn how to add AI with local models and APIs to Windows apps.
Qualcomm® AI Hub Models is our collection of state-of-the-art machine learning models optimized for performance (latency, memory etc.) and ready to deploy on Qualcomm® devices.
A toolbox for spectral compressive imaging reconstruction including MST (CVPR 2022), CST (ECCV 2022), DAUHST (NeurIPS 2022), BiSCI (NeurIPS 2023), HDNet (CVPR 2022), MST++ (CVPRW 2022), etc.
